caption: The drawing depicts a chandelier, centrally placed on a plain background. The chandelier has six arms, each ending in a candle holder with an upright candle. The arms extend outward and curve gracefully, with each candle holder resting on a round base. The central body of the chandelier is composed of geometric shapes forming a vertically symmetrical structure, from which the arms emerge. At the top, a chain is attached for hanging. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of grey and black, characteristic of pencil or graphite on an off-white or beige paper, with clear shading and shadowing to indicate depth. At the lower left corner, there is a scale marked "1.5” = 1’ scale," and the name "Columbus Simpson" is inscribed in the lower right corner. The composition is clean with a large blank margin surrounding the chandelier.
title: Candle Chandelier
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
